```{r fig.height = figures_height_rmd_output}
# --- PLOT ORIGINAL DATA MEAN ± 95 % CI --- #

for(trophy_i in 1:length(trophy_selected)) {
  
  print(trophy_selected[trophy_i])
  
  ggarrange(plot.ecosystems.points.legend(ds_ecosystems %>% 
                                            filter(disturbance_percentage == "fixed"),
                                          trophy_selected[trophy_i],
                                          response_variable_selected,
                                          legend_row_n_input = 4),
            plot.ecosystems.points(ds_ecosystems %>% 
                                     filter(disturbance_percentage == "fixed"),
                                   trophy_selected[trophy_i],
                                   response_variable_selected,
                                   legend_row_n_input = 4)  +
            rremove("xlab") +
            theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                  axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
                  legend.position = "none") +
            font("legend.text", size = size_legend) +
            font("ylab", size = size_y_axis) +
            ggtitle(fixed_label),
          plot.ecosystems.points(ds_ecosystems %>% 
                                   filter(disturbance_percentage == "decreasing_with_size"),
                                 trophy_selected[trophy_i],
                                 response_variable_selected,
                                 legend_row_n_input = 4)  +
            font("xlab", size = size_y_axis) +
            font("ylab", size = size_y_axis) +
            ggtitle(relative_label) +
            scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(ds_metaecosystems$day)) +
            theme(legend.position = "none"),
          heights = c(0.2, 0.6, 0.6),
          nrow = 3,
          align = "v") %>%
    print()
  }
```

```{r}

# --- PREPARE DATA FOR ANALYSIS --- #

data_for_analysis = ds_ecosystems %>%
  filter(time_point >= first_time_point_model,
         time_point <= last_time_point_model,
         !is.na(!!sym(response_variable_selected))) %>%
  mutate(ecosystem_ID = as.character(ecosystem_ID),
         size = as.character(ecosystem_size_ml),
         conn = factor(x = ifelse(connection == "connected", 
                                  "con", 
                                  "unconnected"),
                       levels = c("unconnected", "con")))
```

```{r eval = (response_variable_selected == "bioarea_mm2_per_ml")}

# --- CREATE MODEL --- #

# Prepare data

data_for_analysis = data_for_analysis %>% 
  rename(dis_per = disturbance_percentage)

# In the ouput lmerModLmerTest which means that it's a Linear Mixed Model from the lmerTest package

basic_model = lmer(get(response_variable_selected) ~
               size * conn * dis_per * trophic_type +
               (1 | ecosystem_ID) +
               (1 | day),
   data = data_for_analysis,
   REML = FALSE,
   control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"))

# Extract residuals from the basic model

data_for_analysis$residuals <- resid(basic_model)

# Fit a new model with varIdent

model <- gls(residuals ~ 
               size * conn * dis_per * trophic_type,
             data = data_for_analysis,
             weights = varIdent(form = ~ 1 | day))

```

```{r eval = (response_variable_selected == "shannon" | response_variable_selected == "evenness_pielou")}

# --- CREATE MODEL --- #

# Prepare data

data_for_analysis = data_for_analysis %>% 
  rename(dis_per = disturbance_percentage)

# In the ouput lmerModLmerTest which means that it's a Linear Mixed Model from the lmerTest package

basic_model = lmer(get(response_variable_selected) ~
               size * conn * dis_per +
               (1 | ecosystem_ID) +
               (1 | day),
   data = data_for_analysis ,
   REML = FALSE,
   control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"))

# Extract residuals from the basic model

data_for_analysis$residuals <- resid(basic_model)

# Fit a new model with varIdent

model <- gls(residuals ~ 
               size * conn * dis_per,
             data = data_for_analysis,
             weights = varIdent(form = ~ 1 | day))
```
